summary: Comprehensive testing of Customer Share Feature (iteration 24). Backend: 8/8 tests passed - customer-share endpoint correctly strips all price fields and is publicly accessible. Frontend: CustomerMotorView page at /klant/motor/{id} works correctly - shows motor details without prices, has info banner, 404 state works. Share buttons in MotorcycleDetail.js are correctly implemented but could not be fully tested in preview environment due to redirect to production URL.

issues: Image placeholder shows motorcycle icon when no images available - acceptable fallback

Backend: customer-share excludes internal fields (visible_to_dealers, visibility, created_by, etc.)
